Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
Is a bleed for 0 a successful action for Freak Drive (inferior); or
anything else?

(clearly it isn't a "successful bleed" but it is an action that resolved
[for 0] so is arguably successful as an action -though from LSJ's 1997
post I think not..)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


An action that reaches resolution unblocked is successful.
A bleed action can be successful (unblocked) even if the bleed is not
(resolves for less than 1).
